How It Works

$FT Pulse(The Heartbeat)

Live $FT buys, milestones and daily activity directly inside the FRENZY Telegram channel.

$FT Blaze(Discover What's Moving)

A BNB Chain discovery board weighted by volume, liquidity, transactions, unique buyers and momentum.

$FT Flare(Attention Becomes Inventory)

When FRENZY has traffic, BNB Chain projects can pay to appear on the discovery board for a defined window.

$FT Lily(Fairer Opens)

Lily is FRENZY's anti-snipe launchpad, designed to give new BNB Chain launches a protected opening window.

$FT Forge(From Signal to Execution)

The intended trading layer inside the same Telegram bot, bringing wallets, buying, selling and trading into the room where the community already lives.

Six-Month Roadmap

One development phase, not a stack of sprints. Each utility opens to the room only once the one before it is live.

MONTH 1
Foundation

Brand kit, site, whitepaper and graphic roadmap. BotFather token, channel admin and contract wiring set up. $FT Pulse listener and post templates built.

MONTH 2
$FT Pulse Live

Pulse in production: live $FT buys, dust gate, no-sell tape, recaps and milestones, Telegram admin commands. The channel becomes publicly useful.

MONTH 3
$FT Blaze

Ranking engine, safety gates, scheduled board and on-demand command. $FT home-token pin. Blaze opens to the room once Pulse has a stable tape.

MONTH 4
$FT Flare Rails

On-chain payment in BNB, USDT and discounted $FT. Automatic activation and expiry. Paid rows marked and kept isolated from organic Blaze.

MONTH 5
$FT Lily + Flare

Flare goes live. The Lily pad opens: protected first-block window, wallet cap at T0, $FT-discounted launch slots. Optional dashboard for orders.

MONTH 6
$FT Forge Gate

Security scope and a test trading surface for Forge. No public custody until that review is complete. Pulse, Blaze, Flare and Lily are hardened for load.
